answer:
In Norwegian, "see you next week" is:

**«Vi ssees neste uke.»**

You can also say:
- **«Ses neste uke!»** This is a shorter, casual version.
- **«Vi snakkes neste uke.»** This means "we'll talk next week." Use it when you'll speak by phone or online.
- **«Ha en fin uke, vi sees neste uke!»** This means "Have a good week, see you next week!"

Pronunciation: *vee seess NES-teh OO-keh*.

The wording is the same in Bokmål. In Nynorsk, "uke" becomes "veke": *«Vi sjåast neste veke.»*

answer:
På norsk sier du:

**«Ses neste uke!»** (bokmål)

Det er den vanligste og mest naturlige måten å si det på. Her er noen andre alternativer:

- **«Vi sees neste uke.»** betyr «We'll see each other next week.» Den er litt mer avslappet.
- **«Vi snakkes neste uke.»** betyr «We'll talk next week.» Den brukes når dere skal snakkes på telefon eller nettet.
- **«Hyggelig å se deg neste uke.»** betyr «Nice to see you next week.» Den er litt mer formell.
- **«Ha en fin uke, vi sees neste uke!»** betyr «Have a nice week, see you next week!»

Uttale: «ses» uttales omtrent som «seess», og «uke» som «ÆÆ-keh» med en lang u-lyd, nesten som «ew-keh».

Website relaunch sits under Northwind, so I'll check that one first.

**The relaunch is on track for go-live on 1 March 2027.** The steering group confirmed that date on 14 October (item:eed72cc5, item:af561e93).

- The budget is 450,000 NOK, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October (item:b8c4b9d2).

- **Per Hansen (Northwind):** hosting and DNS (item:478c0a94). Hosting will be on Azure, decided on 14 October.
- **Mona Lie (Northwind legal):** approval of the cookie banner.
- **Lars Moe (CMS vendor):** looking into the API limit.

**Progress**
- The design was approved on 23 September.
- 60% of the content was migrated as of 15 October (item:90435cbb).

**Open risks**
1. **CMS vendor API limit:** the API allows only 10 requests a second, which slows the content migration. Lars at the vendor is looking into it (item:3468e285).
2. **Cookie consent banner:** Mona Lie in Northwind legal must approve it before launch (item:b362faa3).

**Coming up**
- You owe Gunnar the revised timeline by 22 October (task:728bce14).
- The next steering group meeting is on 11 November. The task to book a room is still open (task:65979e77).

The launch checklist covers redirects, analytics, the cookie banner, the DNS change and a last content check.

# 2026-10-20 Status — Northwind website relaunch

**Go-live remains 1 March 2027, with an approved budget of NOK 450,000.** The latest recorded delivery update is **60% of content migrated as of 15 October**; two explicit risks remain open: CMS API throttling and legal approval of the cookie banner. There is not enough recorded information to confirm overall schedule or budget health.  
Sources: item:09a7c766-e053-4123-b2be-91ece4d055b7; item:8e1ee1db-5bdd-4fb0-9d4b-ff18e87fb552; item:723def39-e2ec-47d0-baec-3e45f1adb1a9.

## Date and budget

- **Go-live:** 1 March 2027, reaffirmed by the steering group on 14 October.
- **Approved budget:** NOK 450,000, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October. Actual spend, commitments and forecast-to-complete are not recorded in the information available.
- **Possible increase—not approved:** Your private note says Gunnar hinted at an additional NOK 100,000 if the pilot goes well. This is not committed funding.

Sources: item:2a29ac90-db5a-4b4a-a0bf-a234d97d65c0; item:8e1ee1db-5bdd-4fb0-9d4b-ff18e87fb552; item:7c336644-2c0b-4b8d-a140-fdb04afdf06c.

| Owner | Responsibility |
|---|---|

| **Per Hansen** | Hosting and DNS; requires DNS changes announced one week ahead. |
| **Lars Moe, CMS vendor** | Investigating the API rate limit slowing migration. |
| **Mona Lie, Northwind legal** | Cookie and personal-data review, including cookie-banner approval. |
| **Lise Berg** | Procurement; requires purchase orders before invoices. |
| **You, Ana** | Existing action to send Gunnar the revised timeline by **22 October**. |

- **Approved:** NOK 450,000, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October.

- **Financial visibility:** No actual spend, remaining budget or forecast-at-completion was found in the available records.

# 2026-10-20 Status — Northwind website relaunch

**Go-live remains 1 March 2027, with an approved budget of NOK 450,000.** The latest recorded progress is **60% of content migrated as of 15 October**; the main open risks are slow CMS migration and outstanding legal approval for the cookie banner.

## Go-live and budget

| Area | Current position |
|---|---|
| **Go-live** | **1 March 2027**, reaffirmed by the steering group on 14 October. (item:c42c8b22-d846-4cba-a7b8-e6b3e40a7149) |
| **Approved budget** | **NOK 450,000**, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October. Actual spend, commitments and forecast-to-complete were not found in the records reviewed, so budget health cannot yet be assessed. (item:e530d929-e696-4a7b-8779-e07f3d03242f) |
| **Possible increase — private, unapproved** | Gunnar hinted at an additional **NOK 100,000** if the pilot goes well. This is not committed funding. (item:10cccf1c-d13d-4da5-a54a-582e7c945673) |

## What is done / where work stands

- **Design approved** on 23 September. (item:42b79bb3-ed4f-4ef1-982d-af3c5b357396)
- **Migration 60% complete** as of 15 October. The migration covers about 1,200 pages, with product pages first and news last. (item:65aefed1-4c88-495c-b433-2a5b488ed826; page:27d2a0fc-ffc4-4558-937e-896d53ac273e)
- **Azure selected** on 14 October, aligning with Northwind’s existing IT environment and keeping data in Norway. (item:90d9e6ce-32aa-47c7-a42f-baca290b46b2; item:f1a34cb4-4d32-4794-9cae-7f1d09382d7e)

answer:
**Short answer:** Go-live is 1 March 2027 (kept at the steering group on 14 October). Several things are still open before then.

**Launch checklist** (item:57216994): redirects, analytics, cookie banner, DNS change and a last content check.

**Open items**
- **Content migration:** 60% was done on 15 October, with about 1,200 pages in total. Product pages go first and news last. The CMS vendor's API allows only 10 requests a second, which slows this down. Lars at the vendor is looking into it. Cara owns the migration.
- **Cookie banner:** Mona Lie in Northwind legal must approve it before launch.
- **Hosting and DNS:** Per Hansen at Northwind owns both. Staging on Azure starts 1 November. The DNS change is still to do.
- **Redirects:** Old addresses need redirects to the new pages. The list is in the shared drive.
- **Analytics:** Matomo replaces Google Analytics. Northwind still wants the same monthly report as today.
- **Accessibility:** The site must meet WCAG 2.1 AA, and the outside audit is planned for February. That leaves little time to fix anything before launch.
- **Newsletter:** The signup has to move to the new site at launch.
- **Translations:** Norwegian and English must be ready at launch. Swedish comes later.

**Your own tasks:** Send Gunnar the revised timeline, due 22 October (task:1fff92e0).

**Next steering group meeting:** 11 November.

The pages don't record owners or dates for redirects, analytics, the newsletter or the final content check. I can save these as tasks if you want.

answer:
## Gunnar call — tomorrow, Wednesday 21 October

**Aim: agree the revised timeline and what needs unblocking to protect the 1 March 2027 launch.**

### Your opening
“The steering group kept 1 March as our launch date and agreed on Azure. As of 15 October, content migration was 60% complete. I’d like to confirm the remaining milestones and agree how we handle the migration bottleneck and outstanding approvals.”

### Key points to cover
- **Migration risk:** the CMS API is limited to 10 requests/second. Lars at the vendor is investigating; Cara owns migration. Get an updated progress estimate before the call if possible.
- **Northwind content:** confirm who will deliver the new product-page copy and by when.
- **Legal approval:** agree a target date for Mona Lie to approve the cookie banner.
- **Revised timeline:** walk through remaining milestones and dependencies. Your task to send it to Gunnar is due **Thursday 22 October**.
- **Next checkpoint:** the steering group meets **11 November**. Agree what should be ready by then.

### Questions worth asking
1. “Are there any changes in business priorities that should affect the timeline?”
2. “Can we agree dates for the product copy and legal sign-off?”
3. “What would you need to see to consider the pilot successful?”

### Budget and communication
- **Approved budget:** NOK 450,000.
- **Private context, not a commitment:** Gunnar hinted at a possible additional NOK 100,000 if the pilot goes well. Don’t treat it as approved.
- He prefers **short summaries and email**. Keep the call decision-focused, then send a brief recap with owners and dates. **Any pricing must go through Northwind’s procurement portal, never email.**

**Leave with:** an agreed timeline, named owners and dates for blockers, and clear expectations for 11 November.

answer:
## Call with Gunnar — Wednesday, 21 October

**Focus on the revised timeline: what needs to happen to protect the 1 March launch, and where Gunnar’s help is needed.**

### Key facts to have ready
- **Launch:** 1 March 2027, reaffirmed at the 14 October steering meeting. Hosting on Azure was also agreed. [Meeting notes](page:e1c02c8a-ed23-4821-97e4-7035b6e30695)
- **Progress:** 60% of content migrated **as of 15 October**—get a fresh figure rather than presenting this as current. Cara owns migration. [Project](page:bfddd105-920f-42bb-89d0-f0889b2cb2d6)
- **Main risks:** the CMS API rate limit is slowing migration; Lars is investigating. Mona’s approval of the cookie banner is needed before launch. [Risks](page:bfddd105-920f-42bb-89d0-f0889b2cb2d6)

### Suggested agenda
1. **Timeline:** Walk through remaining milestones and ask: “Are these dates and dependencies realistic from Northwind’s side?”
2. **Content:** Confirm who will deliver Northwind’s new product-page text, and by when. Northwind owns that writing. [Workshop agreement](item:3d1a9b0c-6408-4533-8b8b-ab570a3a433c)
3. **Blockers:** Agree whether Gunnar needs to help escalate the API issue or secure a legal-review date.
4. **Close:** Recap decisions, owners and dates. Your revised timeline is due to Gunnar **Thursday, 22 October**. [Existing task](task:a3949ff2-c69f-4dc7-84d5-f2f8f90fa57c)

### Suggested opening
> “I’d like to use this call to check the revised timeline against the March launch, confirm the remaining content commitments, and agree any help needed on migration and legal approval.”

**Private watch-out:** The approved budget is **450,000 NOK**. Gunnar’s suggestion of another 100,000 NOK was conditional on pilot success—not an approval. If relevant, ask what success criteria would unlock it. Any pricing must go through Northwind’s procurement portal, never email. [Budget](item:72fc7c26-7af3-417e-b3e8-305c2c2330e9) · [Potential increase](item:9af67d9f-5594-4bb6-8185-edfd95af74b1) · [Pricing rule](item:5a2301a5-0f1a-4b6f-ad25-442bbb667dc4)

Keep it brief and decision-focused; Gunnar prefers short summaries. A concise follow-up email with decisions and the timeline would fit his style—without pricing. [Preference](item:53f47f85-74d6-43eb-9b5f-f0ecd2461340)

answer:
**"Vi ses neste uke."** (pronounced roughly "vee SEHS NEH-steh OO-keh")

- **Vi ses** means "we'll see each other". It's the usual casual way to say "see you".
- **neste uke** means "next week".

A few variations:
- **Ses neste uke**: a shorter, more casual form.
- **Vi snakkes neste uke**: "talk to you next week", if you'll be speaking rather than meeting.
- **Ha en fin uke, vi ses neste uke**: "Have a nice week, see you next week."
- In Nynorsk, it's **"Vi ses neste veke."**

answer:
**Go-live is 1 March 2027, confirmed at the 14 October steering group (item:1c6220d7). These items are still open:**

1. **Content migration** is about 60% done as of 15 October (item:2f6cdc86).
   - About 1,200 pages are moving, product pages first and news last.
   - Cara owns it.
   - The CMS vendor's API allows only 10 requests a second, which slows the work. Lars at the vendor is looking into it (item:37046424).
2. **Cookie consent banner** still needs approval from Mona Lie in Northwind legal (item:9b70bd84).
3. **Hosting and DNS** are Per Hansen's.
   - Staging on Azure starts 1 November (item:a58f01d2).
   - The DNS change is on the launch checklist.
4. **Redirects** from old addresses to the new pages must be in place. The list is in the shared drive (item:df920dc8).
5. **Analytics** has to be set up in Matomo, which replaces Google Analytics. Northwind wants the same monthly report as today (items:175a1381, 13ca73c2).
6. **Newsletter signup** has to move to the new site at launch (item:f937efb5).
7. **A last content check** is the final step on the launch checklist (item:ea57e613).
8. **Accessibility** must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. The outside audit is planned for February, so it's close to the launch date (items:f7a786b2, 90637b53).
9. **Norwegian and English versions** both have to be ready. Swedish comes later in 2027 (item:8cbdf92b).

**Your own task:** send Gunnar the revised timeline by 22 October (task:858ed9c9).

**Next steering group meeting:** 11 November (item:0edc001f).

The notes don't say who owns the redirects, analytics or newsletter work, or when they're due. The design was approved on 23 September (item:2f43a5f2), so it isn't open.

answer:
## Gunnar call — tomorrow, Wednesday 21 October

**Aim: agree the revised timeline and resolve the main delivery risks, while keeping the 1 March 2027 launch date.** You owe Gunnar the revised timeline by **Thursday 22 October**.

### Your opening
> “I’d like to confirm the revised timeline, check the migration risks and agree what we need from Northwind next. The launch date remains 1 March, as agreed at last week’s steering group.”

### Key facts to have ready
- **Migration:** 60% complete **as of 15 October**; Cara owns it. Get a fresh update before quoting this as current.
- **Hosting:** Azure agreed on 14 October; staging is scheduled from **1 November**. Per owns hosting and DNS.
- **Budget:** **450,000 NOK approved**. The possible extra 100,000 NOK Gunnar hinted at is **not committed**.
- **Next steering group:** 11 November.

### Priority questions
1. **Migration bottleneck:** The CMS API is limited to 10 requests/second; Lars is investigating. Does this affect the revised timeline, and when should it be escalated?
2. **Northwind content:** Who will deliver the new product-page copy, and by when?
3. **Legal approval:** Can Gunnar help secure a date for Mona’s approval of the cookie banner?
4. **Timeline agreement:** What must be settled tomorrow so you can send the revised version on Thursday?

### Close with clear commitments
Confirm an **owner and date** for each open issue, plus any decisions needed before 11 November. Keep the February accessibility audit visible in the timeline.

**Style:** Gunnar prefers short summaries. Keep the call focused and follow up with a brief decision-and-action email; **any prices must go through Northwind’s procurement portal, never email**.

"See you next week" in Norwegian is **"Vi ses neste uke"**.

Some variations:
- **"Ses neste uke"** is a shorter, more casual version.
- **"Vi snakkes neste uke"** means "we'll talk next week". Use it when you'll speak by phone or online rather than meet in person.
- **"Ha det bra, vi ses neste uke"** means "Goodbye, see you next week".

Pronunciation of "Vi ses": roughly *vee SEHS*. In "neste uke", the "u" is a rounded vowel, a bit like the "ee" in "see" with your lips rounded.

answer:
Website relaunch sits under Northwind, so I'll use that one and also check the parent.

**The relaunch is on track for go-live on 1 March 2027.** The steering group confirmed that date on 14 October. The two open risks are the CMS API rate limit and the cookie banner approval.

**Go-live:** 1 March 2027 (item:8dd6356f, item:7a7094e4). The next steering group meeting is 11 November. Staging on Azure starts 1 November.

**Budget:** 450,000 NOK, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October (item:d5596a15).
- Your private note says Gunnar hinted it could grow by 100,000 NOK if the pilot goes well (item:643e26f8). That isn't confirmed, so I left it out of the figure above.

**Progress:**
- The design was approved on 23 September.
- 60% of the content was migrated as of 15 October. About 1,200 pages are moving, product pages first and news last.
- About 40% of the old pages are being dropped.
- The site launches in Norwegian and English. Swedish comes later in 2027.

**Who owns what:**
- **Gunnar Holm** (Northwind head of marketing) is the sponsor.
- **Cara** owns the content migration.
- **Per Hansen** (Northwind IT lead) owns hosting and DNS. Hosting is on Azure, decided on 14 October.
- **Northwind** writes the new product page texts.
- **Mona Lie** (Northwind legal) approves the cookie banner.
- **Lars** at the CMS vendor is looking into the API limit.
- **Lise Berg** runs Northwind procurement and needs purchase orders before any invoice.

**Open risks:**
1. **CMS API limit.** The vendor's API allows only 10 requests a second, which slows the migration. Lars is investigating (item:3740d65a). With about 40% of the content still to move, this is the one to watch.
2. **Cookie consent banner.** It needs Mona Lie's approval before launch (item:b4eade11). It is also on the launch checklist.
3. **Product page texts.** Northwind is writing them, and I found no delivery date. This is my inference, not a logged risk.

**Your next deadline:** send Gunnar the revised timeline by 22 October (task:8709d4ee).

**Not recorded:** I found no budget spend-to-date and no due dates for the risks.

# 2026-10-20 Status — Northwind website relaunch

**Go-live remains 1 March 2027; the approved budget is NOK 450,000.** The latest recorded progress is **60% of content migrated as of 15 October**; two documented risks remain open: migration speed and legal approval of the cookie banner.  
References: item:bcf65e12-5b28-4746-bd63-09780c395879; item:29e2e74f-a8ba-4c46-bc70-7ee56b417ec1; item:3c6e1f92-561a-4835-b5b0-efdee81ded06.

## Budget
- **Approved:** NOK 450,000, approved by Gunnar Holm on 2 October.
- **Potential increase—not approved:** Gunnar privately indicated a possible additional NOK 100,000 if the pilot goes well. This is not committed funding.
- **Spend and forecast:** No actual expenditure, remaining balance or forecast-to-complete was found in the available records.

References: item:29e2e74f-a8ba-4c46-bc70-7ee56b417ec1; item:1023823e-d003-4f17-b26c-67824837c7af.
